title: Chapter 5: The Art of Enhancing the Spiritual Root
paragraphs: When Ding Jinglue announced the end of class, the entire classroom rushed to the Cultivation Chamber.
Chen Mobai deliberately lagged behind, missing the first wave. He stomped his feet and sighed loudly, feigning a need to use the restroom before slipping into Teacher Ding's office.
At the Immortal Sect, classes were held only in the morning, with the afternoons reserved for self-cultivation.

After class, students and teachers alike flocked to the Cultivation Chamber. Except for veterans like Ding Jinglue, whose potential had already been exhausted and who were destined never to reach Foundation Establishment, others like Chai Deyun seized every moment outside of teaching to cultivate.
Yet even so, only Ding Jinglue ever relinquished his reserved slot in the Second-Tier Spiritual Energy Cultivation Chamber.
Chen Mobai had initially expected to find only Old Man Ding in the office at this hour.
But as he reached the doorway, he discovered he wasn't the only student present.
It wasn't Song Zheng, Ding Jinglue's designated successor, but Yan Bingxuan, another Late-Stage Qi Refinement prodigy in their class.

Her unadorned face radiated natural beauty, her long hair cascading over her shoulders. Even the loose school uniform couldn't conceal her slender figure. Noticing Chen Mobai at the door, she frowned slightly, then bowed respectfully to Old Man Ding before excusing herself and leaving.
Chen Mobai nodded at Yan Bingxuan as she emerged from the room. After a moment's hesitation, she returned the nod.
Their social circles within the class were different. Though classmates, they were only nodding acquaintances.
Still, Chen Mobai couldn't help but notice that Yan Bingxuan seemed even colder and more aloof this semester compared to the last.
As if to match her name, this prodigious cultivator was growing increasingly aloof.

"Chen Mobai, why aren't you waiting in the Cultivation Chamber? What brings you here?" Old Man Ding, who considered himself quite the jokester, greeted him. Chen Mobai smiled politely and entered the room.

"It's like this, Teacher Ding," he began. "My mother hired a private tutor to help me prepare for the college entrance exams, specifically in practical spellcasting. Yesterday, he assigned homework: to break a Water Wave Restriction. But I'm too dull-witted to solve it. I had no choice but to come ask for your guidance."
Old Man Ding didn't suspect a thing.
After all, the best way to improve in spell cultivation was through constant practice.
While the school offered a broad curriculum, its instruction in specific spells and Restrictions often fell short compared to private tutors outside the academy.

"Your mother certainly doesn't hold back—private tutoring isn't cheap, you know," Old Man Ding remarked casually as he searched his magical database for the origin of the Water Wave Restriction, based on Chen Mobai's description.
"My mother has high expectations," Chen Mobai replied evasively, "I can only do my best. I'm grateful for your guidance, Teacher Ding."

Unwilling to elaborate further, Chen Mobai offered only vague answers. He then proceeded to explain in painstaking detail how he had repeatedly tested the Water Wave Restriction with coins within the Water Abode.
"Hmm, based on your description, it's highly likely this Restriction is formed by solidifying three spells," Ding Jinglue concluded.

Having given up on achieving Foundation Establishment, Ding Jinglue had devoted himself entirely to education. Eager to assist Chen Mobai, who had proactively sought his guidance, he retrieved three spells from his personal database:
Flowing Water ShieldSurging Wave Spell * Scale Wave Technique

"The specific spell details and methods to break the Restriction have been transferred to your personal database. Go home and experiment thoroughly. If you still can't crack it, write a detailed report and send it to me."
Seeing Ding Jinglue bundle the spell documents into a compressed file and send it to his interface address, Chen Mobai expressed his sincere gratitude.
Accessing these three spells from the Immortal Sect Spell Library would have cost him at least thirty Merit Points.
Moreover, without Ding Jinglue, a teacher deeply versed in magical arts, Chen Mobai would have spent days and nights searching the vast sea of information online.
The school's benefits are truly exceptional!
Chen Mobai sighed sincerely. This was precisely why they placed such importance on the college entrance exams.
If one could gain admission to the Great Dao Academies, they would gain free access not only to magical arts but also to Boundary Breaking Secret Arts and Divine Abilities and Immortal Arts.
On Diyuan Star, thanks to the legacy of the previous mechanical civilization, knowledge was largely without gatekeeping.
The Immortal Sect's Soul Transformation Secret Arts, for example, could be obtained freely once one's cultivation reached the Late-Stage Nascent Soul realm.
It was precisely this open ethos that allowed the Immortal Sect to continue producing Soul Transformation Patriarchs even in Diyuan Star, a realm with depleted resources.
"By the way, Teacher Ding, was Yan Bingxuan here earlier to consult you about magical arts?" Chen Mobai asked impulsively as he was leaving, remembering the earlier incident.

"Her? After reaching the Late-Stage Qi Refinement realm, she seems to have decided to transform her Gold-Water Dual Attribute True Spiritual Root into an Ice Spiritual Root. She was asking me for insights on purifying and enhancing Spiritual Roots."
Chen Mobai hadn't actually expected an answer, but Ding Jinglue's direct reply stunned him into wide-eyed amazement.
"This... Can Spiritual Roots actually be transformed and enhanced?"
"Oh, you haven't reached that level yet. But there's no harm in telling you now."
Ding Jinglue tapped his keyboard twice, selected a document, and teleported it to Chen Mobai.

"The reason I was granted special admission to the Pure Yang Palace was because I spent twenty years in seclusion at the Dan Zhu Academy, cultivating diligently to transform my Spiritual Root into the Three Yang Constitution. It's considered a variant of extraordinary Spiritual Roots."
"However, though twenty years of relentless effort elevated my Spiritual Root to High-Grade, it left me with insufficient time to reach Qi Refinement Completion."
"You all know the rest of my story. Even with the Three Yang Constitution, I failed at Foundation Establishment twice, exhausting my potential."
Chen Mobai skimmed the document Ding Jinglue had sent him, finally understanding the reason behind his earlier statement.

On Diyuan Star, where resources were scarce, the Immortal Sect's great powers had focused their efforts on developing spells and cultivation techniques, hoping to improve the overall aptitude of their cultivators.

Six thousand years ago, Venerable Tianbo created the "Gold Refining Art," which could enhance the attributes of Gold-element Spiritual Roots. When cultivated to its peak, it could transform an ordinary Pseudo Spiritual Root in someone under twenty into a Gold-element Heavenly Spiritual Root.
By now, the Immortal Sect possessed over a dozen secret techniques for purifying and enhancing Spiritual Roots.
Even methods to transform Spiritual Roots into Ice, Lightning, or Wind attributes were widely circulated among the Great Dao Academies and Palaces.

"The better your Spiritual Root, the faster your cultivation will progress. However, the more time you spend enhancing your Spiritual Root, the less time you'll have for Qi Refinement practice. I'm a prime example of this."
"That's why the Immortal Sect forbids teaching these techniques in classes before university. It's to prevent you from being distracted."

"Once you reach university, each Great Dao Academy and Palace will have its own secret techniques for purifying and enhancing Spiritual Roots, tailored to their specific cultivation traditions. However, whether you choose to cultivate these techniques remains a personal decision."
